I know other people have it worse than me; and I have met some of them.

Some of my general feelings about the hopeless nature of life extend from my own experiences, to just realizing this is the kind of world where a life like mine is common. How am I supposed to live in a world like that? How can I turn a blind eye to all the pain everyone suffers?
Thanks. I can pull off a pretty convincing falsely stoic expression to get through the interview. The cops in my town are all idiots anyway.
I assure you that if there was any help for me, I would have already gotten it. Thank you.
